q3-us-reits-p3-desoto-pc-item7b-digital-.summary: The 135-page agenda-item document opens with the Community Development Department's memo to the Planning Commission, meeting date 22 September 2026. Digital Realty has submitted a site plan to build a data center along Lexington Avenue between 99th and 103rd Streets; under the zoning regulations the Planning Commission reviews and approves site plans and 'makes the final decision'. The phase-one application proposes one two-storey data center 61.5 ft high with a 30 ft louver screen and about 225,000 sq ft per level (450,000 sq ft in total), 189 parking spaces, four loading docks, temporary construction trailers, one private electric substation and one operated by Evergy (Polaris). Staff found the architectural, landscaping, photometric, traffic, noise and stormwater submittals compliant and recommended approval with conditions to be met before occupancy permits. The attached application names the project 'Digital Astra North (Project Jayhawk)', location north-east of 103rd Street and Lexington Avenue, legal description portions of Astra Enterprise Park 2nd Plat, current and proposed zoning M-1, proposed use data center.
